visualization.notes: Both drugs have 1000 trials each. Phase 2 dominates for both (Pembrolizumab 595, Nivolumab 584), followed by Phase 1 (379 vs 335) and Phase 3 (121 vs 103). Nivolumab has notably more 'Not Applicable' phase trials (103 vs 52). Other phases are similar in count.
visualization.query_interpretation: User wants to compare the distribution of study phases for two drugs, Pembrolizumab and Nivolumab. Using comparison_entities with query_intr for each drug and grouping by phase. No date restriction or status filter specified.
